title: Sticker overlay on legitimate QR
description: A scammer places their own QR sticker on top of a real merchant's QR code. The merchant name in the QR does not match the shop name visible in the photo.

advice.en: Check that the sticker matches the shop name and is not pasted over another code.
advice.id: Pastikan stiker sesuai dengan nama toko dan tidak menempel di kode lain.

title: Personal-name merchant at a business location
description: The QR merchant name is a personal account rather than the registered business name seen at the location.

advice.en: Verify the merchant is registered to the business, not an individual's account.
advice.id: Pastikan pedagang terdaftar atas nama usaha, bukan akun pribadi.

title: Static QR with a suspicious amount
description: A static QR code (type 11) includes a transaction amount, which is unusual and may indicate tampering.

advice.en: Static QR codes normally do not set an amount. Ask the merchant to generate a fresh dynamic QR.
advice.id: Kode QR statis biasanya tidak memiliki jumlah. Minta pedagang membuat QR dinamis baru.

title: Copy-pasted QR with broken CRC
description: The QR payload has an invalid CRC, suggesting it was edited or copied incorrectly.

advice.en: Do not pay. The QR data may have been tampered with.
advice.id: Jangan membayar. Data QR mungkin telah diubah.

title: Generic merchant name
description: The merchant name is overly generic, such as 'TOKO ONLINE 123' or 'WARUNG MAKMUR', with no clear link to the shop.

advice.en: Generic names are easy to fake. Confirm the merchant identity before paying.
advice.id: Nama umum mudah dipalsukan. Konfirmasi identitas pedagang sebelum membayar.

title: Missing QRIS domain
description: The QR payload does not contain a recognized QRIS identifier in the merchant account information.

advice.en: This does not look like a standard QRIS code. Ask the merchant for a valid QRIS QR.
advice.id: Ini tidak terlihat seperti kode QRIS standar. Minta pedagang menunjukkan QRIS yang valid.

title: Empty or missing merchant name
description: The QR payload has no merchant name, making it impossible to verify who will receive the payment.

advice.en: A valid QRIS code must show a merchant name. Do not pay if the name is blank.
advice.id: Kode QRIS yang valid harus menampilkan nama pedagang. Jangan bayar jika nama kosong.

title: Partial name similarity
description: The merchant name partly matches the shop name but is not identical. This can be a typo, rebrand, or warning sign.

advice.en: The names are close but not the same. Double-check with the merchant before paying.
advice.id: Namanya mirip tapi tidak sama. Periksa lagi dengan pedagang sebelum membayar.

title: Unusually high or rounded amount
description: The QR amount is much higher than expected or suspiciously round, which can indicate a tampered dynamic QR.

advice.en: Compare the amount with your expected bill before confirming payment.
advice.id: Bandingkan jumlah dengan tagihan yang diharapkan sebelum membayar.

title: Mixed merchant account identifiers
description: The QR contains conflicting merchant account information from multiple acquirers or identifiers.

advice.en: Conflicting account details are a red flag. Ask the merchant to show the original QR.
advice.id: Detail akun yang bertentangan adalah tanda bahaya. Minta pedagang menunjukkan QR asli.
